newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were moderately active. Both classes were steady.
Steers - part load choice blacks predominantly 3 near 1300 lbs 66.50. High select and choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 64.00-66.00. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 61.00-64.00. Select 1-2 58.00- 61.00.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1050-1200 lbs 63.00- 65.00. Select and choice 2-3 1000-1125 lbs 60.00-63.00. Select 1-2 58.00-60.00.
